نفتتح (form VIII)
# نَفْتَتِحُ (naftatiḥu) /naf.ta.ti.ħu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِفْتَتَحَ (iftataḥa)
# نُفْتَتَحُ (nuftataḥu) /nuf.ta.ta.ħu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِفْتَتَحَ (iftataḥa)
# نَفْتَتِحَ (naftatiḥa) /naf.ta.ti.ħa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِفْتَتَحَ (iftataḥa)
# نُفْتَتَحَ (nuftataḥa) /nuf.ta.ta.ħa/:
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
